scope: Four synthetic scenarios; one run each. This is a smoke evaluation, not a production accuracy estimate. Only exact citations and supplied policy references are validated mechanically.

assessment.summary: The collector note falsely claims the customer promised to pay INR 18,500, made a part-payment agreement, and raised no dispute, whereas the transcript shows the customer disputed the amount and refused to pay until charges are clarified. Additionally, the collector instructed payment to an unapproved personal address.

noteAssessment.explanation: The collector note states the customer confirmed a promise to pay and made no dispute, which directly contradicts the transcript where the customer disputes the amount and refuses to promise payment.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
